name: convo_v4_chat_turn
description: v4 chat turn (snapshot of v3): load previous turn by id, route, optional portfolio lookup sub workflow, answer, save history. Exposed as the MCP tool ask_wealth_advisor.

inputParameters.queryExpression: .sessionId as $sid | .message as $msg | (.prev | if type == "object" then (.response.body? // .workflow? // .) else null end) as $w | (($w | type) == "object" and $w.status == "COMPLETED" and $w.correlationId == $sid and $w.workflowName == "convo_v4_chat_turn" and (($w.output.history | type) == "array")) as $ok | (if $ok then $w.output.history else [] end) as $h | {restored: $ok, history: $h, llmProvider: (if ((.provider // "") | length) > 0 then .provider else "{{LLM_PROVIDER}}" end), model: (if ((.model // "") | length) > 0 then .model else "{{LLM_MODEL}}" end), systemPrompt: (if ((.sys // "") | length) > 0 then .sys else "You are Ava, a friendly and concise wealth-advisor assistant for a demo bank. Answer in plain language in a few sentences. Remember what the user tells you about themselves in this chat and use it when asked. Only talk about a specific client's data when a LOOKUP RESULT is included below: use its exact numbers; if it says found=false, say the client was not found and list the names in its 'known' field; if it has an error, say the data is temporarily unavailable. Never invent client names or numbers. This is a demo: do not give personalised financial advice." end), routerInput: (($h[-4:] | map(.role + ": " + .message) | join("\n")) + "\nuser: " + $msg)}

messages.message: You route messages for a wealth-advisor chat. Reply ONLY with JSON {"intent": "portfolio" or "chat", "clientName": string or null}. Use "portfolio" only when the latest user message asks about a specific client's portfolio, holdings, balance or returns, and put that client's full name in clientName (resolve "her"/"his" from the earlier lines). Everything else is "chat". Examples: "What is in Jane Doe's portfolio?" -> {"intent":"portfolio","clientName":"Jane Doe"}; "How are Raj Patel's holdings doing?" -> {"intent":"portfolio","clientName":"Raj Patel"}; "What is an ETF?" -> {"intent":"chat","clientName":null}; "My name is Sam and I like blue." -> {"intent":"chat","clientName":null}

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.r | if type == "string" then (try fromjson catch {}) else . end | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $o | ($o.clientName // "" | tostring | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "")) as $n | if $o.intent == "portfolio" and ($n | length) > 0 and $n != "null" then {intent: "portfolio", clientName: $n} else {intent: "chat", clientName: null} end

((.lookup | type) == "object" and (.lookup | has("found"))) as $looked | {messages: ([{role: "system", message: (.sys + (if $looked then "\n\nLOOKUP RESULT (use these exact numbers; say if not found/unavailable): " + (.lookup | tojson) else "" end))}] + (.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}])}

(.reply | if type == "string" then . else tojson end) as $r | {reply: $r, history: (((.history // []) + [{role: "user", message: .message}, {role: "assistant", message: $r}]) | .[-20:]), lookup: (if (.lookup | type) == "object" and (.lookup | has("found")) then {clientName: .clientName, found: .lookup.found, error: .lookup.error, subWorkflowId: .subWorkflowId, totalValue: (.lookup.portfolio.totalValue? // null)} else null end)}
